resources.name: Synapse-RS API
resources.description: Synapse-RS HTTP endpoints — maintained in dev-tools/, updated as endpoints land (same rule as the oracle repo: never let it drift).

resources.name: GET /api/health
resources.description: Liveness check — 200 with {"status": "ok"} while the server is up. Deliberately shallow: it must NOT check Postgres, or a store blip becomes a restart loop. Wire livenessProbe here. (step 01, split in 41)

resources.name: GET /api/ready
resources.description: Readiness check — 200 {"status":"ready"} when Postgres answers, 503 {"status":"not ready"} when it does not, so the orchestrator stops routing traffic here. The failure reason is logged, never returned (store errors name hosts and users). Wire readinessProbe here. (step 41)

resources.name: GET /api/synapse/index
resources.description: The browsable library index — kind-discriminated category/book tree. Carries the content cache header. (step 06)

resources.name: GET /api/synapse/search
resources.description: Full-text search across every mounted source — lesson PROSE, not just titles. `q` is the query (the last word matches by prefix, so partials work); `limit` defaults to 20 and is capped at 50. An empty or unusable `q` is a 200 with no results, because the palette sends whatever has been typed so far. Each hit carries a snippet already split into marked and unmarked runs.

resources.name: GET /api/synapse/{paths…}
resources.description: A lesson payload by its directory-mirror path (category…/book/chapter…/lesson) — raw markdown + frontmatter + full prev/next. (step 06)

resources.name: execution
resources.description: Rate limited (step 18): anonymous 10/60s per IP, signed-in 100/3600s per sub; over the window = 429 + retry seconds in the ApiError detail (no Retry-After header).

resources.name: POST /api/run
resources.description: Run one snippet in the go-judge sandbox. A badly-running program is a 200 with a non-Accepted status; 422 unknown language, 413 over the byte caps, 503/502 backend. (step 10)

resources.name: GET /api/synapse/c4-doc/{elementId}?lesson=
resources.description: A LikeC4 component's tutorial doc — the co-located _c4-docs/<leaf>.md sidecar next to the lesson. (step 06)

resources.name: GET /api/synapse/d2/{hash}/{slug}
resources.description: One board of a d2 walkthrough, proxied from the d2-render sidecar as image/svg+xml, immutable. CONTENT-ADDRESSED (ADR-RS009): {hash} is the fence source's fnv1a and {slug} the board's, both from the manifest the lesson page inlines on the .d2-boards element — there is no lesson path and no fence name any more. The renderer drew every board when the page asked for the root, so this is a cache read. 404 if the walkthrough was never rendered; 502 if the sidecar is down. Unmounted entirely when SYNAPSE_D2_RENDER_URL is unset, and the reader's viewer compiles the walkthrough itself.

resources.name: submissions
resources.description: POST shares the step-18 rate-limit gate (429 + 'Sign in for a bigger submission budget.').

resources.name: progress
resources.description: Per-user completion (the reader's ✓ ticks). Mark/reset require a bearer; GET is [] when anonymous. Reset clears progress ONLY — submissions survive.

resources.name: POST /api/progress
resources.description: Mark one lesson complete for the caller (idempotent); returns the caller's full completed list. 401 when anonymous.

resources.name: GET /api/progress
resources.description: The caller's completed lesson paths (anonymous → []).

resources.name: DELETE /api/progress
resources.description: Reset the caller's progress — clears the ✓ ticks; submissions are untouched. 401 when anonymous.

resources.name: DELETE /api/progress/{path}
resources.description: Un-mark ONE lesson for the caller — the end-of-page "Mark as read" switch turned off. The path is the /-joined lesson path and spans several segments. Idempotent: un-marking a lesson that was never marked is a 200 with the list unchanged. Returns the caller's remaining completed paths, mirroring POST. 401 when anonymous.

resources.name: POST /api/submissions
resources.description:
Submit a solution — 202 + id; the suite judges in the background (step 14). 404 not-a-problem, 500 invalid suite.

Allowlist (step 20): with SUBMISSION_ALLOWLIST_ENFORCED=true (prod), anonymous → 401 'Sign in to submit', unlisted username → 403 'Submitting is allow-listed on this deployment'. Dev default = open.

resources.name: GET /api/submissions/{id}
resources.description: Poll one submission until status == completed (step 14).

resources.name: GET /api/submissions?path=
resources.description: Submissions for a lesson, newest first (identity later scopes it to the caller).

resources.name: GET /api/auth/config
resources.description: The SPA's Keycloak coordinates, split from the issuer (step 16).

resources.name: GET /api/me
resources.description: Who am I — requires a bearer; 401 missing/invalid, 503 verifier down (step 16).

resources.name: DELETE /api/submissions/{id}
resources.description: Owner-only delete — 401 anonymous, 403 someone else's (step 16).

resources.name: DELETE /api/submissions
resources.description: Erase every submission of the caller — reset my data (step 16).

resources.name: blog
resources.description: The flat, chronological blog: markdown posts at synapse-content/blog/<slug>.md (drafts are _-prefixed and never ship). Same markdown pipeline as lessons, no workbenches.

resources.name: GET /api/blog
resources.description: The listing: [{slug, title, summary, publishedAt, tags, readMinutes, eyebrow}], newest first (undated last). Public content read — carries the edge cache header.

resources.name: GET /api/blog/{slug}
resources.description: One post: frontmatter + markdown body + prev/next slugs (publish order; prev = older, next = newer, null at the ends).

resources.name: GET /api/blog/{unknown}
resources.description: An unknown slug is a 404 + ApiError.

resources.name: DELETE /api/me
resources.description: Delete the caller's sign-in via the SCOPED synapse-admin service-account client (client_credentials, realm-management:manage-users only — never the master admin). Bearer required. App data is the separate DELETE /api/submissions verb; the account page orchestrates erase → delete → sign-out. Keycloak-admin-down → 503, never a swallowed success.

resources.name: admin
resources.description: The allowlist panel's API (step 21). Admin-gated per call: ADMIN_USERS config (dev default 'tester'), compared lowercase against the verifier's canonical username. MeDto.admin is UX only.

resources.name: GET /api/admin/allowlist
resources.description: Every grant, newest first. Anonymous → 401; verified non-admin → 403 'Admin only'.

resources.name: GET /api/admin/lesson-views
resources.description: Readership (step 49): most-read lessons first. limit defaults to 50, clamps to 1..500. Anonymous → 401; verified non-admin → 403 'Admin only'. Counts only — no reader, no session, no IP is ever recorded.

resources.name: POST /api/admin/allowlist
resources.description: Grant (upsert): username trimmed + lowercased server-side; blank → 400; returns the stored row.

resources.name: DELETE /api/admin/allowlist/{username}
resources.description: Revoke → 204; unknown grant → 404.

resources.name: tutoring
resources.description: The local Socratic coach (step 22, ADR-S025). OFF by default; when off, chat is a STRUCTURAL 404 (the route is never mounted). Enable locally: TUTOR_ENABLED=true (+ TUTOR_URL/TUTOR_MODEL; Ollama default http://localhost:11434, llama3.1).

resources.name: GET /api/tutor/config
resources.description: Always answers: {enabled, model} — 200 even when the coach is off.

resources.name: POST /api/tutor/chat
resources.description: One coaching turn: the FULL transcript up, one reply back. Backend down → 503 + TUTOR_URL hint; backend error → 502. 404 while disabled.

resources.name: GET /media/{path} (lesson media, cache 1h, range-aware)
resources.description: Serves content_root/_media; public,max-age=3600 on 200 AND 206; single bytes= range honoured.

resources.name: GET /simulators/{sim}/ (simulator bundle, first-source-wins)
resources.description: Serves every mounted source's _simulators/ tree, probed in mount order. A directory (WITH trailing slash) resolves to its index.html; without the slash it 301s to the slash form so relative ./assets/ URLs resolve. html: public,max-age=60; every other asset: public,max-age=3600.

resources.name: authoring
resources.description: In-app prose editing. Mounted only when CONTENT_FORGE is not 'off'; dev defaults to 'dry-run', where the whole flow runs and only the forge call is skipped. Every verb but /config needs a bearer AND a place on the content_editor_allowlist (a SEPARATE grant from the submit allowlist).

resources.name: GET /api/edits/config
resources.description: Whether editing is on and whether THIS caller may use it. Answers for anonymous too (canEdit: false), because the lesson page asks before it knows who is reading.

resources.name: GET /api/edits/source/{path}
resources.description: The lesson file WHOLE, frontmatter fence included, plus the fingerprint POST /api/edits demands back. 401 anonymous, 403 not allow-listed, 404 not an editable page.

resources.name: POST /api/edits
resources.description: Propose the edit. Reuses this contributor's open pull request for this page (another commit) or opens a new branch. 409 when baseFingerprint no longer matches the file on disk.

resources.name: GET /api/edits
resources.description: The caller's own change requests, newest first. The stored state is a cache refreshed on submit, not per read.

resources.name: GET /api/admin/content-editors
resources.description: Who may propose prose edits. Separate from the submit allowlist: this grant opens pull requests under the deployment's token.

resources.name: POST /api/admin/content-editors
resources.description: Grant (upsert). Usernames are trimmed and lowercased server-side; blank is a 400.

resources.name: DELETE /api/admin/content-editors/{username}
resources.description: Revoke — 204 on removal, 404 when the grant never existed. Change requests already open are untouched; closing those is a reviewer's call.

resources.name: GET /api/admin/content-sources
resources.description: Which repositories feed the library, in mount order, with the fetch loop's sync state. The primary checkout is absent: it arrives by git-sync and is always first.

resources.name: POST /api/admin/content-sources
resources.description: Register a satellite guide repo. Keyed on the id derived from `repo`, so posting the same repository again edits its row. The book appears once the next fetch lands it, not on this call.

resources.name: DELETE /api/admin/content-sources/{id}
resources.description: Forget a repository. The cached checkout is reclaimed by the fetch loop; nothing is deleted on the forge.

resources.name: POST /api/admin/content-sources/sync
resources.description: Ask the reconcile loop to run now instead of on its next tick. 202 when it was asked; 503 when the loop is not running (SYNAPSE_CONTENT_SYNC_SECONDS=0).

resources.name: GET /api/admin/content-warnings
resources.description: What the merge resolved across sources. While a book exists in two repositories, duplicateBookSlug names the copy actually serving — read this before deleting either.
